business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Procurement of Battery-Grade Lithium Carbonate Powder

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Independent State of Samoa (Malo Saʻoloto Tutoʻatasi o Sāmoa)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus), in force since 2020
ACP-EU Interim Partnership Agreement (Economic Partnership Agreement framework)
OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework on BEPS membership
Bilateral Tax Information Exchange Agreements with Australia, New Zealand, and Nordic states

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (Samoa), as amended by the Money Laundering Prevention (Amendment) Act 2017, ss. 16-24 (customer due diligence and UBO record-keeping) and ss. 3, 46 (Financial Intelligence Unit powers); International Companies Act 2008 (Samoa), ss. 12-15 (incorporation and register of shareholders) and s. 42 (registered agent custody of beneficial ownership particulars); licensing conditions of the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) binding on registered agents; FATF 40 Recommendations and Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation standards applicable to Samoa.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each proposed director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or sworn notary of the UBO's origin country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization where origin state is not an Apostille contracting party)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank financial reference letter for each UBO and corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or notarial certification accepted by the Samoan registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Incumbency, and current register of members for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate shareholder's home registry or licensed registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized affidavit of source of funds and source of wealth in respect of lithium carbonate procurement trade lines
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary of the UBO's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for each corporate shareholder or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home registry of the corporate shareholder (e.g., Companies House or equivalent foreign registry)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence where any UBO, director, or signatory is a Politically Exposed Person under FATF Recommendation 12, covering foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs, and PEPs by family or close associate connection. Automated screening against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK Sanctions List, and domestic Samoa designations promulgated under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007. Screening must be performed at formation and continuously during SWIFT LC and wire-transfer settlement. Adverse media and commercial screening-database checks (World-Check/Refinitiv-equivalent) are required before incorporation and on any change of UBO.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) International Companies Registry; online lodgment through licensed registered agents via the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) Companies Online portal (www.mcil.gov.ws and SIFA e-services module)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the International Companies Act 2008, the registered legal name must be expressed in English or Samoan using Latin (Roman) script only. Non-Latin script trading names (e.g., Chinese characters) must be transliterated into an approved Latin-script legal identifier; the transliterated name is the sole registered identifier, while a Chinese-character rendering may appear in unofficial translation-only materials. The company name must ordinarily end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' unless exempted by the Registrar.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Appeal SOP: (1) obtain the Registrar's written refusal notice identifying the statutory ground; (2) within 14 days of refusal, the registered agent may lodge a revised name application or request written reasons; (3) file a formal administrative appeal with the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days of the refusal, attaching the reserved-name certificate, comparison schedule, trademark search results, and grounds of distinctiveness; (4) the Minister decides on the written record; (5) any adverse decision may be challenged by judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa. The 30-day reservation window is not extendable; re-submission of an identical name restarts the statutory clock, so parallel alternate-name reservations should be maintained.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. The statutory registered office must be the physical office of the licensed Samoan registered agent in Apia. Virtual operations are acceptable for the lithium carbonate procurement and brokerage activity because no statutory factory-level presence is required, but the International Company must maintain a registered agent, a physical custody location for statutory registers, and any economic-substance documentary evidence at the agent's office. Full 'no substance' virtual structuring is not available, as distribution-and-service-centre mobile business activity requires demonstrable board management and control consistent with Samoa's economic substance framework.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 10-20% probability in the first operating year of an unannounced or short-notice inspection by the Registrar/Samoa International Finance Authority or the Financial Intelligence Unit. Probability rises above 25% upon high-risk wire or letter-of-credit activity, PEP triggers, or third-party information-exchange requests made under tax transparency arrangements.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and search for up to five proposed company names
Government incorporation and registration fee for an International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of International Companies (Samoa International Finance Authority)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille of Certificate of Incorporation, Articles, and agent certificates (three apostilles)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Samoa (Competent Authority)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent fee (year one, including registered office, agent services, and UBO register maintenance)
UBO/AML customer due diligence file preparation and PEP, OFAC, UN, and EU sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent compliance officer / commercial screening database vendor

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of passport copies, bank reference letter, and source-of-wealth affidavit in the UBO's origin country
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Public notary of the UBO's jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence opinion and name-rejection appeal readiness
Courier and secure digital transmission of the apostilled incorporation bundle

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended; Part II (Incorporation), ss. 14-16 (registered office), ss. 25-31 (directors and secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Government of Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form ICA-01: Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The subscribed capital may be denominated in any currency, and payment for issued shares must be held in the registered agent's client/escrow account until the first board resolution; shares are then issued as fully paid.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscriber hereby acquires one ordinary share of USD 1.00 in the Company, and upon payment of the capital subscription into the registered agent's client account, such share shall be issued fully paid. (2) The registered office of the Company shall be at the office of the registered agent, Apia, Samoa, and the Registrar of International Companies is hereby notified. (3) [Name] is appointed Director and [Name] is appointed Secretary, each to serve until the first annual meeting, with authority to execute formation documents, open bank accounts, and make lawful filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage a Licensed Registered Agent and Confirm Name Availability
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa, acting through a Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a Samoa-licensed registered agent, present the proposed company name, and instruct the agent to conduct a name search in the International Companies Register. The agent will reserve the preferred name and obtain a name availability certificate before incorporation.
required_dossiers: Notarised passport copy of the intended shareholder/ultimate beneficial owner
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
Business bank reference letter
Proposed company name and two alternates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the desired name is refused or already reserved, propose an alternate name or request a minor variation from the Registrar; no resubmission fee is incurred for alternate names.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Notarise the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent and Samoa Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act 1987. The subscriber and first director must sign the constituent documents before a notary, with witness attestation and corporate seal affixation.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of proposed registered capital and share classes
Consent and appointment forms for first director and secretary
Name approval certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a requisition for defective signatures or exhibits, rectify the signature pages, re-notarise, and resubmit the corrected documents to the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodge the Incorporation Application with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia (via authorized online portal submitted by the registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form ICA-01, the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, the statutory declaration, the name approval certificate, and evidence of agent consent. The Registrar performs a completeness and legality review and approves the incorporation order.
required_dossiers: Completed Form ICA-01
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name approval certificate
Licensed registered agent's consent letter
Government filing fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any information, the registered agent must file a written response within 14 days, produce supporting affidavits, and amend the relevant exhibit; an extension may be obtained for complex beneficial ownership disclosures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Companies Registry – Certificate Custody Unit, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon final approval and fee clearance, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company name, registration number, and date. The registered agent collects or downloads the certificate and verifies its authenticity against the registry record.
required_dossiers: Approved incorporation application
Payment confirmation for official state filing fee
Registered agent's authorisation letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If issuance is delayed because of treasury or poundage verification, resubmit the payment receipt and request a priority certification by affidavit; lost certificates may be reissued on lodgement of a statutory declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appoint Officers, Adopt the Registered Office, and Open Bank Account Facilities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Board; Registered Agent; Samoa-licensed commercial banks with SWIFT/LC capability
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the first board resolution appointing the director and secretary and confirming the registered office at the registered agent's premises. File the Notice of Director and Secretary with the Registrar. Submit the corporate package to a bank to open the operating and settlement account supporting Swift_LC and Wire_Transfer payment rails.
required_dossiers: First board resolution
Consent forms signed by director and secretary
Certificate of Incorporation
Corporate due diligence pack (passports, references, beneficial ownership statement)
Registered office confirmation from the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects the officer notice, cure the defect by re-filing the consent forms. If a bank denies account opening, supplement the anti-money-laundering file with enhanced due diligence and a lawful-purpose declaration, or apply to an alternate licensed bank.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None applicable to a non-resident International Company engaged in offshore wholesale procurement. If a physical warehouse, processing plant, or factory is later established in Samoa, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) and the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) would become the competent industrial and environmental authorities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating licence or manufacturing permit is required at formation. Should local physical operations begin, a Business Licence under the Samoa Business Licensing Act 1998 and a Factory/Industrial Permit under the Labour and Employment Act 2013 would be required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), EIA Division, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category 3 (No Full EIA required) for an offshore procurement/trading entity without construction, land disturbance, or discharge activity within Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or solid-waste discharge is generated under the current cross-border trading model. Should any future physical storage be established, compliance with the Samoa Environment Act 1998, Waste Management Regulations 2005, and applicable national effluent and air quality standards will be mandatory, including a zero-discharge protocol for hazardous battery minerals.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No separate civil-defence clearance is required for the offshore entity itself. If a local administrative office is established, the registered agent's premises must maintain a current Fire Evacuation Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority and a Building Compliance Clearance from the MCIL Building Division for structural load safety.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Samoa — statutory tax administrator under the Tax Administration Act 2012, the Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) Act 1992 and the Customs Act 2014; headquartered at Apia with the official taxpayer e-Services portal (eMfR) at www.revenue.gov.ws. Samoa Customs Service (export/import clearance, ASYCUDA World) operates within the MfR.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Samoa International Companies (ICs) under the International Companies Act 1987 are automatically tax-exempt on all international business and are not required to hold a Samoan Taxpayer Registration Number (TRN) for pure offshore lithium carbonate procurement/re-invoicing (ISIC 4662 / NAICS 423510) because no income is sourced in Samoa and no taxable activity is carried out there. Where a domestic nexus is created (local warehousing, domestic sales, resident employees, or imports for local consumption): (1) submit the MfR TRN application with the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles, Certificate of Good Standing, registered agent/office confirmation and the IC's tax exemption status documents; (2) verify identity through the eMfR/eServices portal; (3) file VAGST registration if Samoan taxable supplies reach WST 100,000; (4) receive TRN and VAGST certificate from MfR. Foreign non-resident companies without a Samoan fixed establishment may obtain VAGST registration only through a Samoan tax representative authorized by MfR.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: International Companies Act 1987 grants ICs an automatic, renewable 20-year guaranteed exemption from Samoan income tax, VAGST, stamp duties, withholding taxes and exchange control on non-Samoan-sourced business; no Samoan domestic entity-classification election exists because the exemption is statutory. For U.S. federal tax purposes, a wholly-owned Samoan IC elects its classification via IRS Form 8832 check-the-box (corporation by default; disregarded entity or partnership available), filed before the first U.S. tax return. Hybrid-mismatch considerations: the IC may operate as a reverse-hybrid conduit but must be documented against OECD BEPS Action 2 and Samoan General Anti-Avoidance Rules (Tax Administration Act 2012) to preserve the tax-exempt position in cross-border battery-metals arbitrage.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) — a VAT-styled GST under the VAGST Act 1992 (as amended), administered by the Ministry for Revenue; import/export customs duties under the Customs Act 2014 are a separate indirect tax layer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover (approx. USD 36,000); compulsory VAGST registration for any person carrying on a taxable activity in Samoa once taxable supplies exceed WST 100,000 in any 12-month period; voluntary registration allowed below threshold. Offshore trading transactions of a tax-exempt IC are excluded from the Samoan territorial scope and do not count toward the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction controls, e-invoicing APIs, or digital stamping. Binding digital obligations: (i) e-filing of VAGST returns and tax payments via the MfR eServices/eMfR portal; (ii) electronic customs declarations and manifests through ASYCUDA World for any physical Samoan import/export; (iii) prescribed VAGST tax invoice content (issuer TRN, recipient TRN where registered, supply description, date, quantity/price and VAGST amount), with electronic records retention subject to MfR audit access.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAGST zero-rating is restricted to registered persons supplying: (a) goods physically exported from Samoa within the statutory time limit (~28 days from supply, extendable by MfR) supported by customs export evidence; (b) international transport services; (c) services supplied to non-residents for consumption wholly outside Samoa. The target IC (cross-border procurement of battery-grade lithium carbonate powder, goods moving directly from third-country producer to downstream buyer without entering Samoa) makes no supply in Samoa and has no VAGST nexus: no zero-rating claim, refund or credit mechanism is engaged because no Samoan output tax arises on offshore arbitrage margin. If goods are ever physically introduced into Samoa and re-exported, the IC would need VAGST registration and full export substantiation to apply 0%; otherwise the supply is taxed at 10%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic via ASYCUDA World, Samoa Customs Service / MfR)
Commercial Invoice (HS 2836.91 / ISIC 4662 description, incoterms, WST or USD value)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (proof of physical export from Samoa when applicable)
Certificate of Origin (only where preferential trade treatment is claimed)
Inward Remittance Certificate / foreign-exchange receive evidence (for Samoan-registered exporters and applicable exchange permits)
VAGST export certificate or zero-rating substantiation memorandum maintained for MfR post-clearance audit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Samoa enforces export zero-rating through MfR post-clearance audit and ASYCUDA data analytics. Penalties for fraud or sham export/re-invoicing: (i) civil shortfall penalties of 50%-150% of tax avoided under the Tax Administration Act 2012; (ii) late-payment interest at the prescribed statutory rate plus a 20% late-filing penalty; (iii) criminal liability under the VAGST Act 1992 and Customs Act 2014 — fines up to WST 50,000 and/or imprisonment up to seven years for fraudulent evasion; (iv) retrospective clawback of all zero-rated benefits, denial/recapture of input credits and re-assessment of prior periods at 10% VAGST; (v) suspension of eServices/ASYCUDA privileges, increased audit frequency, and enforcement against tax representatives who sign false export certificates. Exchange-control cross-checks expect receipt of export proceeds within 180 days (unless formally extended); tax-exempt ICs are outside Samoa exchange-control requirements but should hold their exemption certificate and documentary chain (purchase order, supplier invoices, shipping records, SWIFT/LC settlements) to rebut any sham-arbitrage assertion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Exchange Control Division, Apia, Samoa
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) is partially convertible. Current-account transactions and normal trade payments are permitted through CBS-licensed authorized dealers, but capital-account transfers, external borrowing, and non-trade remittances require CBS approval or registration. Profit and dividend remittance offshore by an International Company is generally permitted after audit and tax clearance; remittance requests above reporting thresholds require CBS exchange-control notification and evidence of an underlying trade or capital transaction. For the battery-grade lithium carbonate procurement vehicle, USD-denominated receipts should be retained in foreign-currency accounts and settled outside Samoa where possible to minimize WST conversion friction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoa's Exchange Control Act 1976 imposes a 30-day window after export proceeds are credited to a Samoan bank account for an exporter to surrender foreign currency to an authorized dealer; the mandatory conversion ratio is 100% of export proceeds for goods physically exported from Samoa customs territory. Where the International Company operates as an offshore trading intermediary and the lithium carbonate is delivered from a third-country refinery directly to an overseas buyer, no surrender obligation arises in Samoa provided settlement is completed through an approved foreign-currency account and reported as an offshore trading receipt. If proceeds are repatriated into Samoa, a written CBS exemption is recommended to avoid the automatic 100% WST conversion requirement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multicurrency WST/USD) plus Capital Escrow sub-account for subscription funds and trade settlements
Capital Escrow Account (USD-denominated) and Operational Settlement Account for LC/TT disbursements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as the primary settlement rail. Samoa has no local EMI digital banking license and the Central Bank does not treat foreign EMIs as authorized dealers. Platforms such as Wise, Airwallex, or global neo-banks may be used only as auxiliary collection or payment channels for foreign-currency disbursements outside the Samoan regulatory perimeter, provided legal title to funds remains in the International Company's account at a CBS-licensed correspondent bank. EMI accounts inside the Samoa IC structure are not viable for LC issuance, import settlement, or regulatory filings.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is not an absolute requirement. A remote onboarding is possible for International Companies using certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing, a notarized Board resolution, a registered agent confirmation, and a recorded video-conference interview with each signatory and the ultimate beneficial owner. In practice, CBS-approved banks require at least one director or authorised officer resident outside a high-risk jurisdiction to complete a live interview; directors from FATF-listed high-risk states must physically appear at the bank branch or Samoan consulate before signature mandates are approved.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company lacking physical employees, power, or business substance in Samoa.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Memorandum and Articles of Association; Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing; International Company Register extracts; letter of engagement from the Samoan corporate services provider; registered office and agent agreement; board resolution opening the account; organizational chart; detailed business plan for ISIC 4662 wholesale lithium carbonate procurement; signed off-take letter of intent and supplier quotes; forecast ledger of upcoming trade flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner or signatory based in a FATF high-risk or sanctioned jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and PEP screening results; passport and address verification for each UBO and signatory; independent source-of-wealth memorandum; audited financial statements of the UBO or group; bank reference from a regulated institution in the UBO's residence jurisdiction; legal opinion confirming the beneficial ownership structure and confirming no evasion of asset controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value commodity trade flows for battery-grade lithium carbonate that appear inconsistent with the International Company's declared commercial capability or are accompanied by incomplete shipping evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed commercial purchase agreement with the battery-metal refinery or producer; quality specification certificate for battery-grade Li2CO3 of at least 99.5% purity; independent pre-shipment inspection certificate; warehouse receipts, bills of lading, and air or sea waybills; Incoterms schedule; commercial invoices matching bank beneficiaries; supplier and client KYC profiles; FX and shipping insurance documents; LC facility or trade-finance terms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear provenance and economic purpose of inbound capital injections from related parties or treasury centers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-resolved capitalization plan; share subscription agreement; capital account ledger; source-of-funds declarations from the remitting bank; intercompany loan agreement if debt funding is used; group consolidated audited financials; transfer pricing documentation; CBS exchange-control approval or notification for inbound capital; tax identification number and tax residence certificates of the remitter; profit accumulation evidence for any dividend recapitalization.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use a CBS-licensed authorized dealer in Samoa or a foreign regulated bank with a correspondent relationship to Samoa. The preferred route is a SWIFT MT103 from the parent or treasury entity to the International Company's USD account at BSP or SCB, with field 70 containing 'CAPITAL INJECTION / SHARE SUBSCRIPTION' and, where applicable, the Samoan International Company registration number. Each injection must be supported by a board resolution, an updated register of members, and a source-of-funds certificate; amounts exceeding the bank's internal reporting threshold require a CBS exchange-control declaration or approval before credit is made available. WST conversion should be avoided by holding funds in USD.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements must be structured either by a documentary Letter of Credit issued under UCP600 through a Samoan bank and advised through a confirming bank at the refinery's location, using SWIFT MT700 or MT710 for LC issuance or amendment and SWIFT MT103 for drawing settlement, or by direct telegraphic transfer using SWIFT MT103 against supplier invoice, transport document, and quality inspection certificate. Expected rails are USD and CNY clearing through correspondent banks in New York and Hong Kong, plus CNY cross-border direct payments through CIPS where the supplier bank participates. Do not route WST directly to overseas suppliers.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts between WST and USD entered into with a CBS-licensed authorized dealer for known import or export settlement dates
Foreign exchange swaps combining spot and forward legs for liquidity management of WST operating account balances
Cross-currency interest rate swaps on underlying trade-finance or term-loan facilities payable in USD, EUR, or CNY, subject to CBS approval and bank internal credit limits

Non-deliverable forwards on WST or CNY only when contracted with an offshore counterparty outside the Samoan regulatory scope as a good-faith hedge of non-Samoan trade exposures; they are not admissible as onshore legal-tender hedging instruments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Corporate Details Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation; for new incorporations, within 30 calendar days after the first anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 25 per month or part thereof, cumulative up to USD 300; continued non-filing for 12 consecutive months after the anniversary triggers administrative strike-off, loss of legal standing, asset vesting in the Crown, and disqualification of directors; restoration requires Court order, full outstanding fees, and reinstatement penalty.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Renewal Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual return cycle, on or before the incorporation anniversary date each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent and registered office in Samoa constitutes ground for administrative dissolution; the Registrar may cancel the International Company registration and publish the strike-off notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a standard exempt International Company; a compulsory independent audit is triggered only if the company is licensed as a public company, if a shareholders' resolution or shareholder/creditor petition representing at least 10% of voting rights is granted by the Registrar, or if the Court orders an audit for the protection of creditors or the public interest.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB, or IFRS for SMEs as adopted under Samoa International Financial Reporting Standards; statutory accounts need not be filed with the Registrar but must be prepared and made available to members.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must file a Beneficial Ownership Confirmation annually with the Registrar within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation, confirming the current beneficial owners and any shareholding transfers during the preceding year; any transfer of shares involving a new beneficial owner must be notified to the registered agent and Registrar within 14 days of the change. The registered agent must maintain an up-to-date beneficial ownership register and perform customer due diligence on all shareholders in accordance with Samoa's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing requirements.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 1,200 per annum depending on the licensed agent, level of service, and number of registered agent hours; typical mid-market fee USD 650 - USD 850
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable by default; if voluntarily prepared or Court-ordered, a typical independent audit fee for a small exempt international company ranges from USD 2,500 to USD 6,000 depending on transaction volume and account complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% for ordinary resident companies (Income Tax Ordinance 2015, as amended); International Companies are wholly exempt under s.196 of the International Companies Act 1987
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for International Companies: no income tax, no withholding tax on distributions, no stamp duty, no estate duty, no exchange control; no corporate income tax return filing obligation; annual registry return and economic substance notification only; a letter of tax exemption is available from the Registrar upon application

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return applies to Samoan International Companies (ICs), which are statutorily outside the income tax net. The mandatory compliance filing is the SICR Annual Return filed via the Samoa International Companies Registry (SICR) e-Registry portal administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A — Registered Office and Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Samoa and full particulars of the licensed registered agent (name, licence number, contact details)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be a licensed Samoan IC service provider; the non-resident beneficial owner or affiliated trading entity cannot self-appoint as agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, nationality, passport number, residential address, occupation, and date of appointment of each director and the company secretary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident individuals; certified passport copies, proof of address, and professional references are required under the agent's AML customer due diligence obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C — Shareholders and Beneficial Ownership
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholders, class and number of shares, proportionate economic interest, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident ultimate beneficial owner must be disclosed through the licensed agent to the Samoa Beneficial Ownership Register (International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Rules 2018); nominee arrangements require a declaration of trust.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D — Share Capital and Corporate Records
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, currency denomination, and confirmation that the register of members, board minutes, and financial records are maintained at the registered office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital applies; shares may be issued in USD, WST, or another convertible currency; underlying lithium carbonate trade records may be retained overseas but must be produced to the SICR or Commissioner upon lawful demand.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: ESR Declaration Attached to Annual Return
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC is within the scope of the Economic Substance Regulations 2020 and whether any relevant activity (distribution and service centre, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, etc.) is carried on; confirmation of financial year-end
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A battery-grade lithium carbonate procurement vehicle that purchases from a related Chinese or Korean supplier and resells to a Hong Kong affiliate is prima facie engaged in a distribution and service centre activity; the IC must evidence Samoan direction and management or restructure to avoid the substance requirement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a flat penalty of WST 100 plus WST 100 per month or part-month of continued default under the International Companies (Fees and Penalties) Regulations; persistent default for six months or more empowers the Registrar to strike the IC off the register and deregister it, dissolving the entity and vesting its assets, including the lithium carbonate supply contracts, in the Crown.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Economic Substance Return (International Companies (Economic Substance) Return) filed through the SICR portal when a relevant activity is undertaken; additionally e-filed with the Samoa Ministry of Revenue where the IC claims tax-resident status under the Income Tax Ordinance 2015
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of the IC's financial period; the first return is due for the first financial period ending on or after 1 January 2021

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tick-box identifying the relevant activity category: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property, or distribution and service centre
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border procurement and resale of battery metals is a distribution and service centre only if goods are purchased from a related party and resold; purchases from unrelated Chinese producers and sales to unrelated industrial end-users are not a relevant activity, but a nil ESR declaration must still be submitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of gross income, deductible expenditure, net income, and the portion of income derived from relevant activities, namely the lithium carbonate arbitrage margin
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident operators must report gross invoiced sales and intercompany purchase prices transparently; a realised margin persistently below prevailing CME or LME battery-grade lithium carbonate benchmarks will attract transfer pricing scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of Samoan premises, number of full-time employees, expenditure on Samoan staff, rent, utilities, equipment, and a description of core income generating activities (CIGA) physically performed in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a distribution and service centre, CIGA include purchasing and storing goods, managing inventory, negotiating with suppliers and customers, and transporting goods; if these functions occur in Hong Kong or Singapore, the IC fails the substance test and the tax exemption is at risk.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dates and venues of board meetings, attendance and quorum records, minutes, and supporting evidence that strategic decisions are made in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors attending via video link from Hong Kong or China do not satisfy direction and management in Samoa; physical meeting presence, local minute records, and day-to-day oversight in Apia are required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-compliance with the ESR Regulations attracts a fixed penalty of WST 10,000 for the first month of default, a daily penalty of WST 1,000 for continued default, and a cumulative cap of WST 200,000; false declarations expose each director to criminal liability and the Registrar may strike off the IC.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — dividends and distributions paid by a Samoan International Company carry no Samoan withholding tax under s.196(1)(b) of the International Companies Act 1987, overriding the 15% statutory withholding rate that applies to ordinary resident companies under the Income Tax Ordinance 2015.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: DTA relief is administratively unnecessary for outward distributions from a Samoan IC because no domestic withholding tax is imposed. For a shareholder resident in a DTA partner state such as Australia or New Zealand, the home tax authority will generally grant an exemption or foreign tax credit upon presentation of: (i) a Samoa Tax Residency Certificate issued by the Ministry of Revenue for the IC, (ii) the IC's Certificate of Tax Exemption issued by the Registrar of International Companies, and (iii) the text of s.196 of the International Companies Act 1987. The protocol comprises obtaining the TRC within 3 to 5 business days, completing the residence-state exemption form, and annexing the dividend resolution and audited distribution statement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on interest, royalties, and management fees paid by a Samoan International Company (IC Act 1987 s.196); for ordinary Samoan resident companies the statutory rates are 15% for both interest and royalties, reduced to 10% under the Samoa–Australia DTA and similar treaty provisions for non-exempt resident payers.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No fixed statutory threshold is published in Samoa for International Companies. The Commissioner of Taxation may call for contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation under the Tax Administration Act 2012 whenever cross-border related-party transactions are material; in practice, an IC claiming tax exemption with annual lithium carbonate invoicing exceeding WST 100,000 (approximately USD 38,000) must be able to substantiate arm's length margins. The Economic Substance Regulations 2020 additionally mandate retention of a substance file regardless of turnover.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price) — primary method for commodity lithium carbonate, benchmarked against CME and LME battery-grade spot and futures indices
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations 2020, enacted under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2020, require every tax-exempt International Company carrying on a relevant activity, including a distribution and service centre, to demonstrate: (i) direction and management in Samoa evidenced by board meetings held in Samoa and strategic decisions made from Samoa; (ii) adequate physical premises, employees, and expenditure proportionate to the activity; and (iii) core income generating activities physically performed in Samoa. A battery metals arbitrage IC that contracts offshore, holds title offshore, and books margin in Samoa without local management commits a per se substance failure; non-IC resident companies are similarly exposed where their exemption claim generates taxable profit in a foreign parent jurisdiction under CFC or substance-over-form rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Samoan IC as a pure booking vehicle for battery-grade lithium carbonate cross-border arbitrage: no Samoan office, no Samoan employees, no board meetings held in Samoa, no inventory or logistics management in Samoa, while relying on the IC tax exemption to avoid taxation in the parent jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed penalty of WST 10,000 and daily penalty of WST 1,000 up to WST 200,000 under the ESR Regulations; mandatory strike-off and deregistration by the Registrar; referral of the IC's particulars to the OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices; reassessment of foreign-source income at the 27% corporate rate where the exemption is pierced.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director is jointly and severally liable for the ESR penalty and reassessed tax where they knowingly permitted non-compliance; director disqualification for up to 10 years; international travel bans under the Samoa Absconding Debtors Act; criminal conviction for false ESR declaration carries imprisonment of up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Tax Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Under-invoicing or over-invoicing battery-grade lithium carbonate in intercompany trade, for example invoicing USD 8,000 per metric tonne against a market price of USD 14,000 per metric tonne, to shift margin into a zero-tax IC while the high-tax parent claims deductions; absence of a contemporaneous comparability study; use of the IC exemption as an artificial device to shelter profit economically attributable to Hong Kong or Chinese operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Commissioner may adjust taxable income under the general anti-avoidance provisions of the Income Tax Ordinance 2015 at 27%, impose a 50% shortfall penalty under the Tax Administration Act 2012, and apply monthly interest of 1%; criminal tax evasion prosecutions attract fines up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment of up to 3 years per count; parallel CFC and anti-abuse adjustments in China and Hong Kong create double taxation exposure and late-payment surcharges abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve mispriced purchase or resale invoices are personally liable for the resulting tax shortfall under the vicarious liability provisions of the Tax Administration Act 2012; civil restitution of the mispriced margin; cross-border asset freezing orders; extradition risk on egregious fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Trade-Based Money Laundering Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing lithium carbonate purchase and sale payments through personal digital wallets, Hong Kong shell accounts, or unlicensed money service businesses; routing funds through third-party rails unrelated to the invoiced commodity flow; layering settlement proceeds through accounts of the Samoan agent to obscure counterparties; fabricating employee costs to manufacture apparent substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 of Samoa: corporate fines up to WST 1,000,000, freezing orders and forfeiture of arbitrage proceeds, suspension or revocation of the licensed agent's registration, and inclusion of the IC on the Samoan Financial Intelligence Unit suspicious activity watchlist with consequential loss of correspondent banking access.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face imprisonment of up to 7 years for money laundering predicate offences; civil restitution orders against personal estates; asset preservation orders; international travel bans; exclusion from future directorships in Samoa and DTA partner states; regulatory information sharing with HKMA and FATCA exchange networks.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Trading and Abuse of Corporate Form
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Directors permitting the IC to trade while insolvent, distributing lithium carbonate margins through fictitious service fees to related entities, or stripping the IC of all assets before a creditor or tax claim materialises; deliberately conflating the corporate identity of the IC with the parent group's trading operations to evade liability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under s.181 of the International Companies Act 1987 and the Companies Act 2001, the Court may order any director knowingly party to fraudulent trading to be personally responsible for all debts and obligations of the IC, including reassessed tax and penalties; the IC may be wound up and struck off; restraint orders may issue over Swift LC and wire transfer proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution equal to the full amount of the misapplied arbitrage margin; director disqualification orders of up to 10 years; travel bans; criminal liability for fraud with imprisonment of up to 7 years; personal liability extends to shadow directors and de facto controllers resident in Hong Kong or China even without Samoan nationality.
